records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Revenue: For the nine months ended October 31, 2025, revenue was $30.3 billion, an increase of nine percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in subscription and support revenues for the three and nine months ended October 31, 2025 was primarily caused by volume-driven increases from new business, which includes new customers, upgrades, and additional subscriptions from existing customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Remaining Performance Obligation: Total remaining performance obligation, which represents all future revenue under contract yet to be recognized, as of October 31, 2025 was approximately $59.5 billion, an increase of 12 percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have undertaken various restructuring initiatives to improve operating margins and continue advancing our ongoing commitment to profitable growth which included a reduction of our workforce and office space reductions within certain markets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Income from Operations: For the nine months ended October 31, 2025, income from operations was $6.5 billion as compared to $5.4 billion from a year ago.
